results.label: Wake-up card: Oni wins at row 2 or 3
results.brief: Write the wake-up story card shown after Ryo loses a duel to the Oni at row 2 or 3. The run ended at row 5 or earlier.

draft.text: {yokai} brings the club down until the snow runs red, and laughs over what is left of you. You wake screaming at the province's edge, your talismans blank, all but one.

code_issues.problem: 'scream' reads as horror; the tone is never horror.
code_issues.fix: Replace the image with one from the game's world.

critic_issues.quote: {yokai} brings the club down until the snow runs red
critic_issues.problem: The image is gory and shows the yokai brutally harming Ryo, which the tone line forbids.
critic_issues.evidence: 01-vibe/Tone.md#The tone line: No horror: nothing is gory, cruel, demonic or frightening. A yokai that wins walks away; it does not hurt Ryo for pleasure.
critic_issues.fix: Replace the beating with the Oni leaving, e.g. shouldering its club and walking back up to the snowbound shrine gate.

critic_issues.quote: and laughs over what is left of you
critic_issues.problem: The winning yokai gloats over and harms Ryo, and the line implies a killing, which wake-up cards may not show.
critic_issues.evidence: 01-vibe/Story.md#Wake-up cards: The yokai that won does not gloat and does not harm Ryo. It leaves, or goes back to what it was doing.
critic_issues.fix: Have {yokai} turn away, proud and blunt, without laughing or looking back, and go back to what it was doing.

critic_issues.problem: Waking screaming is a frightening, horror-register beat rather than the quiet dusk melancholy the narrator is meant to carry.
critic_issues.evidence: 01-vibe/Tone.md#Voice: the narrator: The narrator is quiet and observant, in present tense. ... The narrator describes what is seen and lets the cost stay unspoken or half spoken.
critic_issues.fix: Use the plain form "You wake at the province's edge" with no screaming.

critic_issues.quote: your talismans blank, all but one
critic_issues.problem: The run ended at row 5 or earlier, so no talisman carries over and every talisman must be blank.
critic_issues.evidence: 01-vibe/Story.md#Talismans: A run that ended at row 5 or earlier leaves every talisman blank.
critic_issues.fix: Drop "all but one" and say simply that the talismans are blank.

draft.text: You wake at the province's edge, your talismans blank. {yokai} shoulders its iron club and walks back up toward the snowbound shrine gate, without a backward glance.

sources.line: A wake-up card after a run that ended at row 5 or earlier says the talismans are blank.
It leaves, or goes back to what it was doing.
The rushdown yokai of the snowbound mountain shrine gate.

code_issues.quote: you wake at the provinces edge your talismans
code_issues.problem: These 8 words in a row are copied from 01-vibe/Story.md; a card is new text, not a quoted example.
code_issues.fix: Say it in new words, with a different image.

draft.text: Snow drifts through the lantern light as {yokai} shoulders its iron club and heads back up to the shrine gate. Ryo stirs at the edge of the province, every talisman blank.

sources.line: A wake-up card after a run that ended at row 5 or earlier says the talismans are blank.
It leaves, or goes back to what it was doing.
The rushdown yokai of the snowbound mountain shrine gate.
Proud and blunt, it dashes in and swings an iron club.

results.label: Elder intro card: Elder Oni
results.brief: Write the one-line intro card shown on the map node of the Elder Oni, before the duel starts.

draft.text: No guard in the province has ever stopped the Elder Oni's club, so do not try to block it.

critic_issues.quote: No guard in the province has ever stopped the Elder Oni's club
critic_issues.problem: The draft says the Elder Oni's club cannot be blocked, but the EVIDENCE gives the elder armour on its specials (they cannot be interrupted) and nowhere says its attacks beat a guard.
critic_issues.evidence: 02-mechanics/Yokai.md#Oni: Elder twist | Armour on every special
critic_issues.fix: Describe the elder shrugging off blows mid-swing, for example jabs landing on its hide while the club keeps coming, instead of claiming no guard can stop it.

critic_issues.quote: so do not try to block it
critic_issues.problem: The card teaches the wrong lesson: the twist breaks mashing jabs to interrupt, not blocking, and the Oni is the yokai that teaches the player to block, so a reader cannot work out the armour twist from this line.
critic_issues.evidence: 02-mechanics/Yokai.md#Oni: Habit the twist breaks | Mashing jabs to interrupt it stops working (also 01-vibe/Story.md#Elder intro cards: Elder Oni | 5 or 8 | Armour on every special)
critic_issues.fix: Rewrite the single sentence so it hints that quick strikes will not stop the Elder Oni's special attacks, and drop the advice against blocking.

draft.text: Quick jabs patter off the Elder Oni's hide, and its iron club keeps swinging straight through them.

sources.line: | Elder Oni | 5 or 8 | Armour on every special |
| Habit the twist breaks | Mashing jabs to interrupt it stops working |
Proud and blunt, it dashes in and swings an iron club.

results.label: Reward card text: Oni's Hide
results.brief: Write the reward card text for the modifier Oni's Hide, offered by the Oni.

draft.plain: The oni's hide shrugs off every blow for the whole move and hits harder too.

code_issues.check: number not in the ability table
code_issues.problem: 'frames' states 12, which is not in the ability table row for Oni's Hide.
code_issues.evidence: | Oni's Hide | Armour on frames 1–5 | no |
code_issues.fix: Use only the numbers in the ability table.

code_issues.check: number not in the ability table

critic_issues.quote: shrugs off every blow for the whole move
critic_issues.problem: The plain line promises armour for the entire move, but the table gives armour only on frames 1–5, so it promises more than the table gives.
critic_issues.evidence: 02-mechanics/Abilities.md#Oni modifiers: Oni's Hide | Armour on frames 1–5 | no (and 01-vibe/Tone.md#Reward card voice: A plain line never promises more than the table gives.)
critic_issues.fix: Say the armour only covers the start of the move, e.g. "The oni's hide toughens the start of this move: it can't be interrupted early on."

critic_issues.problem: Oni's Hide has no damage effect in the ability table; the draft invents a damage bonus.
critic_issues.evidence: 02-mechanics/Abilities.md#Oni modifiers: Oni's Hide | Armour on frames 1–5 | no
critic_issues.fix: Remove the damage claim so the plain line states only the early armour.

critic_issues.problem: The frames line gives the wrong armour window and adds a +10% damage bonus that is not in the ability table.
critic_issues.evidence: 02-mechanics/Abilities.md#Oni modifiers: Oni's Hide | Armour on frames 1–5 | no (and 01-vibe/Tone.md#Reward card voice: `frames` is the exact number from the ability table, with no flavour.)
critic_issues.fix: Change the frames line to "Armour on frames 1–5".
